subject: Object property
notes: kb/Work PB1425 (w1021a). "Identifier-1 shall be an object reference; neither a universal object reference nor the predefined object reference NULL shall be specified" (cite.py --check 8.4.3.9.3 -> OK 2)). Both halves now name this rule under its own code, COBOL2918 (property-object; it shared COBOL0843 with SR1, SR3 and SR4): a universal object (BAL OF U, ReferenceResolver.RosterOf), NULL (BAL OF NULL - a parse error COBOL0901 before the propertyObject suffix existed; OoBinder.OoBindPropertyObject), and a computed object whose item is no object reference. A non-object data name falls out of the property reading to the generic undefined-name diagnosis. [editions: the OO facility, 2002+] retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Binding/ReferenceResolver.cs#OoTryBindPropertyReference (the one-word property binder ReferenceResolver.OoTryBindPropertyReference is deleted by kb/Work PB1425 (w1021a): a property reference is resolved by ReferenceResolver.ResolveObjectProperty, which splits the chain and resolves identifier-3 through the ordinary resolver)
